phrases.latin: Nōbīs enim multō māne surgendum: āëroplanum hōrā decimā et quadrante abscēdet
phrases.english: For we must get up very early: the plane leaves at a quarter past ten

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: ch. X, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
